description: Add a plugin route registration API to daz-script-server so that companion plugins (like daz-bridge-usd) can register their own HTTP handlers on the same port and httplib instance without modifying the server plugin directly.\n\nThe server plugin should expose a Qt-accessible registration method (e.g. registerRouteHandler(method, path, handler)) that other DAZ plugins loaded in the same process can call at startup via DAZ's plugin discovery. title: Add POST /render endpoint (single render, async)
description:
VN production workflows need to trigger DAZ renders programmatically. Without a render endpoint, every render requires manual GUI interaction, making batch sprite production impossible to automate.

Implement POST /render that accepts a render job, enqueues it through the existing AsyncRequestManager, executes on the main thread, and returns a request_id immediately.

Request body schema:
- output_path (required, absolute path)
- width / height (optional, override scene render settings)
- format: png|jpg|tiff|exr (optional, inferred from output_path extension)
- camera (optional, null = active camera)
- engine (optional, null = scene default: iray|3delight|filament)
- figure / morphs (optional, single-figure morph dict)
- figures (optional, list of {name, morphs} for multi-figure scenes)
- iray_samples (optional quality override)

Render jobs use id prefix 'rnd-' and flow through the existing processNextAsyncRequest() path as a special request type. The server generates a DazScript snippet from the morph dict, applies morphs via findPropertyByLabel(), then calls App.getRenderMgr().render(opts). Unknown morph names are silently skipped (non-fatal). Status/result polling via existing /requests/:id/status and /requests/:id/result endpoints.

Open questions to resolve during implementation:
1. morph reset between variants (reset_morphs flag needed?)
2. Figure lookup fallback: error vs fall back to primary figure
3. Add isRender flag to AsyncRequest struct in AsyncRequestManager.h
design:
1. reset_morphs flag: Add reset_morphs: bool to POST /render request body. When true, reset all figure morphs to zero on the main thread before applying the morphs dict and rendering. Required for correct variant rendering when the same figure is reused across batch jobs.

2. Figure lookup failure = error: On figure lookup failure, return an HTTP error (not a silent fallback). Before any render step begins, run a validation pass over the entire figures array to identify all figure references and validate they resolve to scene nodes. This surfaces all bad references at once rather than failing mid-render.

3. RequestType enum instead of isRender bool: Add RequestType enum (REQUEST_TYPE_SCRIPT, REQUEST_TYPE_RENDER) to AsyncRequest struct rather than a boolean isRender flag. Thread it through submit() or a new submitRender() overload. Used in two places: (a) cancelJson() — only invoke killRenderOnMainThread() when cancelling a render request, not any running request; (b) processNextAsyncRequest() — gate render-progress signal wiring for future SSE progress endpoint (owd).
notes:
Implementation complete and tested (2026-05-21). Build clean, installed, verified via live DAZ Studio instance.

API corrections confirmed against running DAZ Studio (dzirayrenderer.dll):
- Image size: new QSize(w, h) — NOT Qt.size() (Qt global undefined in DAZ QScriptEngine)
- Engine switching: renderMgr.findRenderer(className) + setActiveRenderer() confirmed working. Iray className = 'DzIrayRenderer'. 3Delight/Filament class names follow Dz*Renderer pattern but need verification on systems with those plugins.
- Camera: Scene.findCameraByLabel() + App.getViewportMgr().setActiveCamera() confirmed.
- Render: renderMgr.doRender(opts) confirmed.
- Output path: opts.renderImgFilename + opts.renderImgToId = 2 (DirectToFile) confirmed.

Known remaining TODO:
- iray_samples: NOT on DzRenderOptions or DzIrayRenderer object in DazScript. DAZ stores iray-specific settings outside the standard render options API. Field is accepted but silently ignored. Needs further investigation — scene data items path not yet found. Resume investigation in a future session.
close_reason: Closed

title: Add POST /render/batch endpoint for variant rendering
description:
VN production requires rendering many variants of the same scene (expressions, poses) — often 10-30 per character setup. Submitting each individually requires many round trips and makes orchestration harder.

Implement POST /render/batch that accepts a base config plus a list of variants, enqueues each variant as an independent async render request, and returns all request_ids in one response.

Request schema:
  base: {camera, width, height, engine, figure} — shared settings
  variants: [{output_path, morphs, figures, ...overrides}] — per-render settings

Each variant is an independent AsyncRequest with isRender=true. Returns:
  {batch_id: 'bat-...', request_ids: [...], total: N}

Key design point: variants render sequentially (DAZ cannot render two scenes simultaneously), but the HTTP client can interleave other requests between polls. Document both usage patterns:
  Pattern A: submit full batch upfront, poll all request_ids
  Pattern B: submit one at a time, use setup between renders for complex scene changes

Atomicity: if variant N fails, variants N+1..M still render. Per-variant errors in results.
notes: Implemented. POST /render/batch accepts {base, variants:[]}. Base provides optional defaults (camera, width, height, engine, figure/figures, reset_morphs). Each variant requires output_path; merges with base for remaining fields. Figure merge: variant figures/figure wins; variant morphs+single base figure merges morphs (variant overrides). All variants validated and pre-flighted before any are enqueued (fail-fast). Enqueue failures mid-batch return 503 with partial count. Response: {batch_id:'bat-...', request_ids:[...], total:N}. Each rnd-id compatible with existing /requests/:id/status, /requests/:id/result, and GET /render/:id/progress endpoints. Max 100 variants per batch.
close_reason: Closed

title: Add GET /render/:id/progress SSE endpoint
notes: Implemented. New RenderProgressBroker class (plain C++, no QObject) manages per-render SSE subscriber queues. Route: GET /render/:id/progress (auth-gated, SSE with keepalives). Events emitted: 'progress' (percent:0) when render starts executing, 'complete' (output_path, file_size_bytes, duration_ms) or 'error' on finish. Late-joining clients receive stored terminal event immediately. DAZ SDK has no renderProgress(int) signal — DzRenderer only exposes aboutToRender/renderFinished — so no real per-percent progress is possible. Render identity detected by 'rnd-' id prefix.

title: Wire SceneEventBroker into server lifecycle
description:
Integrate broker into DzScriptServerPane start/stop.

Changes to DzScriptServerPane.h:
- Add: SceneEventBroker* m_pEventBroker;

Changes to DzScriptServerPane.cpp:

onStartClicked() / server start path:
- Instantiate m_pEventBroker = new SceneEventBroker(this)
- Call m_pEventBroker->start() -- connects to DzScene signals
- Register GET /scene/events route, passing m_pEventBroker to handler lambda

onStopClicked() / server stop path:
- Call m_pEventBroker->stop() -- disconnects signals, closes all subscriber queues (so SSE handlers exit cleanly)
- delete m_pEventBroker; m_pEventBroker = nullptr;

Server stop must drain SSE handlers before returning. stop() should call queue->close() on all registered queues and then briefly wait (or just let handler threads exit naturally -- httplib will wait for handlers on server stop).

title: SSE endpoint GET /scene/events
description:
Add SSE handler in DzScriptServerPane.cpp (alongside existing handlers).

Route: GET /scene/events

Query params:
- filter= comma-separated list of categories: node,skeleton,light,camera,selection,scene,time,render
  Default (omitted): all categories enabled

Handler logic:
1. Check auth (reuse existing token validation)
2. Check IP whitelist (reuse existing check)
3. Parse ?filter= into bitmask
4. Set response headers: Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, Connection: keep-alive
5. Create SubscriberQueue, register with m_pEventBroker
6. Loop:
   a. pop(15000) -- 15s timeout
   b. If empty (timeout): write ':keepalive\n\n', flush -- client detects disconnect on failed flush
   c. If event: write 'data: <json>\n\n', flush
   d. If flush fails (client gone): break
7. Unregister SubscriberQueue from broker, delete queue

Note: httplib keeps the handler alive for the duration -- this is a long-running handler, same pattern as the existing long-poll result handler.
close_reason: SSE handler added to setupRoutes() in DzScriptServerPane.cpp: auth check, filter parsing, SubscriberQueue lifecycle, chunked content provider loop with keepalive

title: Debounce timers for high-frequency signals
description:
Add debounce logic inside SceneEventBroker for signals that fire at high frequency.

Signals needing debounce:
1. timeChanging() -- fires every frame during playback (~30-60fps)
   Strategy: on timeChanging, start/restart a 150ms QTimer (single-shot)
   On timer fire: emit one time.changed event with current scene time
   On timeChanged() (manual scrub): emit immediately, cancel timer

2. nodeSelectionListChanged() -- can burst during multi-select
   Strategy: 50ms debounce, coalesce into single selection.list_changed

Implementation:
- QTimer* m_pTimeDebounce (150ms, single-shot)
- QTimer* m_pSelectionDebounce (50ms, single-shot)
- Both owned by SceneEventBroker (main thread), so no thread-safety issues
- Store pending time value so debounced slot has current value on fire
close_reason: Implemented in SceneEventBroker.cpp: 150ms debounce for timeChanging, 50ms for nodeSelectionListChanged

title: JSON event serialization for all event types

Output format per event:

Event types and their data payloads:
- scene.loading, scene.loaded, scene.saving, scene.saved(filename), scene.clear_starting, scene.cleared
- node.added(node_id, node_name, node_type), node.removed(node_id, node_name), node.list_changed

- selection.list_changed, selection.primary_changed(node_id, node_name) -- empty data{} if null
- time.changed(time_value, fps), playback.started, playback.finished
- render.started, render.finished

Use existing JsonBuilder for safe serialization. Extract node_id via node->getElementID() or similar DAZ SDK call -- verify exact method name against SDK headers.

title: SceneEventBroker and SubscriberQueue classes
description:
Create include/SceneEventBroker.h and src/SceneEventBroker.cpp.

SceneEventBroker (QObject, main thread):
- Connects to dzApp->getScene() signals via Qt::DirectConnection on start()
- Disconnects all signals on stop()
- Maintains QMutex-protected list of SubscriberQueue*
- registerSubscriber(queue, filter_mask) and unregisterSubscriber(queue)
- Internal: serializeEvent(type, data) -> QString JSON

SubscriberQueue (one per SSE client):
- QMutex + QWaitCondition + std::deque<QString>
- push(const QString& event) -- called from main thread
- pop(int timeout_ms) -> QString -- called from HTTP thread, blocks
- close() -- signals the queue is done (server stopping)

Filter mask: bitmask of event categories (node, selection, scene, time, render, light, camera, skeleton).
close_reason: SceneEventBroker + SubscriberQueue in include/SceneEventBroker.h and src/SceneEventBroker.cpp

title: Document render API with VN workflow examples
description:
The render API design includes a non-obvious batch interleaving pattern that needs explicit documentation and examples to be useful for VN pipeline authors.

Add to README / dazpy docs:
1. Basic single render example
2. Batch variant rendering — pattern A (submit all upfront, poll)
3. Batch variant rendering — pattern B (interleave scene setup between renders for complex changes)
4. Multi-figure scene example (two characters, different expressions)

Emphasize in pattern B docs: because renders are sequential in the async queue, a client can submit render N, wait for it to start, execute scene-setup scripts to configure render N+1, then submit render N+1 — achieving tight coupling between renders without the server needing to understand the full variant state.
